#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""Debug simple CASE statement parsing"""

from sqlvalidator.grammar.tokeniser import to_tokens, lower

def get_tokens_until_one_of_respecting_case(tokens, stop_words):
    """
    Get tokens until one of the stop words is encountered,
    properly handling nested CASE statements by counting CASE/END pairs.
    """
    argument_tokens = []
    
    next_token = next(tokens, None)
    case_count = 0
    
    while next_token is not None and not (
        lower(next_token) in stop_words and case_count <= 0
    ):
        argument_tokens.append(next_token)
        if lower(next_token) == "case":
            case_count += 1
        elif lower(next_token) == "end":
            case_count -= 1
        next_token = next(tokens, None)
